ana_finance: FYI Sunrise Clinic invoice #11012 ($6,300) autopay failed - card declined by issuer. Customer says treasury will send a same-day ACH or wire.
payments-bot: [AUTOPAY] invoice=11012 status=failed decline_code=do_not_honor attempts=2 next_retry=2026-07-12T08:00:00Z
ravi_support: Do we have ACH details for them on file?
jo_billing: No ACH. Portal shows single card token. If they can do same-day ACH, ask for routing+acct+acct type and reference INV11012-SUNRISE for auto-match. If they prefer wire, require screenshot of bank confirmation and reference.
nana_finance: Quick policy note: for amounts under $10k we can allow 24h grace and accept same-day ACH, otherwise wire recommended. This one is $6,300 so OK.
ravi_support: Messaging customer: "We can accept same-day ACH (provide routing, acct, type, acct name) or wire (we'll send instructions). Use reference INV11012-SUNRISE. We'll hold service for 24h while awaiting payment."
jo_billing: Created ticket FIN-7034 for manual reconciliation if needed.
nana_finance: Customer replied: "Sending ACH now, bank provided trace 1122334455 and will email confirmation."
jo_billing: Once screenshot arrives, apply payment and mark original token blocked. Closing when posted. :white_check_mark:
